data.reason: TruTech Motors is a custom-engineered motor manufacturer that designs and builds servo motors to order. The site does not carry off-the-shelf catalog models with specific part numbers, continuous torque values, peak torque values, rated speeds, or pricing for any NEMA 23 servo motor, integrated servo, closed-loop stepper, or brushless DC motor. The services page mentions standard PMSM servo motors available in NEMA 17, 23, 34, and 56 frames with voltage range 12VDC–600VAC and continuous torque up to ~600 lb-in, but no specific part numbers, torque values at the NEMA 23 size, pricing, or detailed specs are listed for any discrete model. The only downloadable spec document found was an application sheet for a custom part MT0861k15.6-E1000B (NEMA 34, continuous torque 15.01 lb-in, peak torque 25.01 lb-in, 80V bus, max speed 6000 RPM) which does not meet the 24 VDC bus requirement and is too low in torque. No datasheet, price, or discrete model meeting the 24 VDC bus with at least 38 oz-in continuous and 55 oz-in peak torque was found.
